scope: Release G5 of the graphics plan (docs/graphics-tripo-plan.md): battle and siege

authorization.source: docs/graphics-tripo-plan.md: release G5, capped at 900 credits on 8 November 2026 and raised to 1,845 with G7's 350 (decision 7) and 595 of G1's (decision 11); decision 9 (9 November 2026) leaves the rest of the plan to my judgement within each release's cap, each pilot reviewed in the game before the rest of its release is generated

pricing.source: the calibration's measured prices (docs/graphics-calibration.md); each task's reported credits_consumed is recorded below

batches.note: Six props at standard texture and geometry, 20 credits each, and one rejected generation redone (20 more): 140 credits within the pilot's 160-credit ceiling. The cart, its load, the barricade and the ram stand on their field objects' cells in the battles, in place of the code-built pieces; the carroballista and the onager stand beyond the board's west edge, behind the Roman line.

balance.source: the account balance read before the first task and after the last (frozen 0)

rejected.note: The load came on a four-wheeled cart of its own, despite the negative prompt; its wheels rise above its bed, so the cart could not be cut away without cutting the sacks. The second attempt, g5-cart-load-b, without the cart in its prompt, ships as g5-cart-load. One of seven generations (14%), under the plan's 20% stop rule.
